headline: Callahan's Gate Changes Hands; Weathered Expanse Erupts Anew
war_summary: Day 302 opens with the map itself stirring. In the Dead Lands, Callahan's Gate changed hands past four o'clock, Wardens taking the post and cutting the Colonial hold to ten of eleven even as the furnace burns—Warden losses near five hundred the hour against Colonial three-seventy, both still climbing. The Weathered Expanse, silent at our last edition, has roared back: twenty-six logged events in a day, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest hardest worked, and one base now lies demolished, leaving four posts apiece. Stlican Shelf tilts to six Warden posts against three, Thornhold the busiest ground, fighting fresh within the hour. The Linn of Mercy re-ignites around Lathair, thirteen events there, Warden losses outpacing Colonial. The Nevish Line, the night's great thunderhead, cools from its peak—Colonial losses still heavier at five thousand four hundred the day—but its eight posts hold for the Warden. Mooring County's flags churned through the small hours, The Wind Hills busiest, yet all twelve stand Warden at press time. Callahans Passage keeps its grind, near ten thousand Colonial and eight thousand Warden lost in a day. No victor; thirty-four victory towns required.
